remaining_open_items: Exact manufacturer orderable part, voltage rating and dielectric binding remain unestablished for the package default.
ESR/ESL versus frequency, leakage, bias-fit coefficients and effective capacitance at operating bias remain part-specific.
A class bench using the supplied V0 law cannot establish a real MLCC DC-bias curve.

Former simulation blocker resolved for the explicitly bound reference (2026-10-08): The exact default part voltage rating is not re-established by these general application documents. Resolution: Archived manufacturer-primary TDK product-center page (FETCH_LEDGER sha f810da9de391..., already cited as S5 in the spec via an Arrow copy, but not yet in this entry's documents) gives the rating for an exact 0805 part: C2012X5R1V106M085AC, 10 uF +/-20%, 35 VDC, X5R, IR >= 50 Mohm. Binding that exact part as an explicit alternative (precedent OHM-044) re-establishes the voltage rating for the bound reference. The spec default (Murata GRM21BR61A106KE19, 10 V) remains unsourced: S4 is only a third-party copy and is not archived, so it must not be the bound part. Add the TDK page to research.documents.
